candidates.verbatim: - **`VMCParaOpt` (parameter optimization)** — verified against the C reference by strict first-10-step integration checks, C ctest-equivalent gates for supported standard fixtures, and `NSRCG = 1` first-step tolerance gates for serial and `mpiexec -n 2`; see the integration tests at `../test/integration/` and MPI smokes at `../test/mpi/`.

- **Threading** — conservative `JULIA_MVMC_INNER_THREADS=1` opt-ins cover selected inner loops. Sample-level `VMCMainCal` threading is intentionally disabled for C-parity; `JULIA_MVMC_PFAPACK_THREADS=1` remains a debug/benchmark triage mode only.

- **MPI** — multi-rank sample-parallel execution is supported through MPI.jl-compatible launchers. `VMCParaOpt` MPI supports direct SR (`NSRCG = 0`) with `NSplitSize >= 1` for `NQPFull = 1` and for sz-conserved standard-projection `NQPFull > 1` when `NQPOptTrans = 1` (`NSPGaussLeg > 1` and/or `NMPTrans > 1`), and standard SR-CG (`NSRCG = 1`) with `NSplitSize = 1`. `VMCPhysCal` supports `NSplitSize > 1` for sz-conserved normal-Green runs (`NLanczosMode = 0`). SR-CG with `NSplitSize > 1`, FSZ/general-orbital PhysCal split, PhysCal Lanczos split, FSZ standard-projection `NQPFull > 1` (`NSPGaussLeg > 1` or `abs(NMPTrans) > 1`), OptTrans-derived QP sectors (`NQPOptTrans > 1` or active `OptTrans`) with `NSplitSize > 1`, additional CG modes (`NSRCG >= 2`), diagonal-scaling CG (`useDiagScale != 0`), and S-matrix rescaling (`RescaleSmat != 0`) are still rejected.

- **Not supported in this release**: BackFlow (`vmc_bf_*` entry points raise an error), `NSplitSize > 1` for SR-CG, FSZ/general-orbital PhysCal split, PhysCal Lanczos split, FSZ standard-projection `NQPFull > 1` (`NSPGaussLeg > 1` or `abs(NMPTrans) > 1`), OptTrans-derived QP sectors (`NQPOptTrans > 1` or active `OptTrans`) with `NSplitSize > 1`, `NSRCG >= 2`, `useDiagScale != 0`, and `RescaleSmat != 0`.
